categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches peer message handling in src/net_processing.cpp to enforce peer disconnection for out-of-order protocol messages.
categories.rationale: Enforces BIP 330 protocol compliance by disconnecting peers sending SENDTXRCNCL after VERACK even when reconciliation is disabled. Reviewers note this is essentially inactive draft code and the node's behavior was already safe, making it a marginal consistency fix.
